description: This file defines various data wrapper classes, indices, and metadata structures used in Spark's status store, including classes for application info, stage info, task info, and related metrics, with annotations for JSON serialization and key-value store indexing.

classes.name: AppStatusStoreMetadata
classes.description: Metadata class for application status store, holding version information.

classes.name: ApplicationInfoWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for ApplicationInfo, providing an ID for key-value storage.

classes.name: ApplicationEnvironmentInfoWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for ApplicationEnvironmentInfo, with a static ID for storage.

classes.name: ExecutorSummaryWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for ExecutorSummary, including host parsing and activity status.

classes.name: JobDataWrapper
classes.description: Wraps JobData with additional skipped stages and SQL execution ID info.

classes.name: StageDataWrapper
classes.description: Wraps StageData, tracking stage ID, attempt, status, and completion time.

classes.name: TaskIndexNames
classes.description: Object defining short string indices for task metrics to optimize storage.

classes.name: TaskDataWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for task metrics and info, with methods for index keys and metric calculations.

classes.name: RDDStorageInfoWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for RDDStorageInfo, indicating cache status.

classes.name: ResourceProfileWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for ResourceProfileInfo, providing an ID.

classes.name: ExecutorStageSummaryWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for executor stage summaries, with composite ID.

classes.name: SpeculationStageSummaryWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for speculation stage summaries, with stage identifiers.

classes.name: StreamBlockData
classes.description: Represents data about stream blocks, including host, executor, and storage info.

classes.name: RDDOperationClusterWrapper
classes.description: Wraps RDD operation clusters, converting to internal cluster representations.

classes.name: RDDOperationGraphWrapper
classes.description: Wraps RDD operation graphs, converting to internal graph representations.

classes.name: PoolData
classes.description: Associates pool names with stage IDs.

classes.name: AppSummary
classes.description: Summarizes application with counts of completed jobs and stages.

classes.name: CachedQuantile
classes.description: Stores quantile metrics for stage attempts, with detailed metric fields.

classes.name: ProcessSummaryWrapper
classes.description: Wraps process summary info, including activity status and host parsing.
